method: Ownership decided from each class's actual responsibility, not from its name. Rule 16 of ARCHITECTURE_RULES.md forbids choosing a target location purely from a class name.

domain_gaps.why_not_migrated: Campaign pricing is the highest-financial-risk path in the application. Moving it without a golden-pricing baseline risks changing arithmetic; Rule 7 forbids copying it and the brief forbids redesigning it.

InventoryService holds the lockForUpdate reservation inside the booking transaction. The brief requires lock order and transaction boundaries to be preserved exactly, so availability is explicitly out of bounds for a structural move.
Settlement is a listed financial hard stop.

domain_gaps.currently_in: NOW migrated to Application/Asset/Services for the pure collaborators; the Eloquent-heavy AssetService, AssetImportService, ScreenDeletionService remain in Services
domain_gaps.why_partial: The two migrated classes depend only on AssetRepositoryInterface, so they are pure Application orchestration. The remaining Asset classes are Eloquent-shaped; relocating them would not clarify ownership.

domain_gaps.observation: Media is already well separated at the integration boundary. The remaining MediaService is an Application-style orchestrator over the two Media contracts and is a good next migration candidate.

domain_gaps.why_not_migrated: Eloquent-heavy (6 Models each); moving them would not improve ownership.
